full_prompt_en: A square architectural installation photograph shows a stepped tower of transparent rectangular modules inside a bright exhibition gallery. The structure rises from a broad, low platform at the bottom of the frame and narrows toward a few upper cubes, with many thin glasslike edges crossing in a regular grid. Light gray walls stand behind it, while a dark ceiling lattice and a row of bright spotlights appear along the top edge. The installation fills nearly the entire width of the frame. Its stacked boxes contain small rooms and platforms at different heights, and pale stairways connect several levels along the left and middle. Some interior areas glow warm white, making their depth visible through the overlapping clear walls. Small green trees or planted forms stand within the structure at several points, their irregular leaves contrasting with the rigid linear grid. Near the center, a lit room and a darker opening break the repetition of clear surfaces. At the lower left, a short run of white stairs climbs into the modules, while the lower right contains more closely packed cuboid rooms and narrow vertical partitions. A pale solid base cuts diagonally across the bottom corners and supports the transparent assembly. The camera looks slightly upward from gallery floor level, so the highest clear boxes approach the ceiling while the lower modules form a dense foundation. Spotlights overhead and warm light inside the modules produce scattered reflections and bright edge highlights. The cool transparent surfaces remain largely colorless, but repeated overlaps create gray, blue white and silver tones. Depth is conveyed by the accumulation of fine lines, small changes in opacity and the occasional lit opening rather than by dark walls. The photograph keeps the gallery setting visible enough to establish scale, yet the grid of clear rooms dominates the image. The overall composition balances a precise ascending geometry with small areas of greenery and warm light, giving the intricate structure an airy, inhabited feel.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑装置照片描绘明亮展厅内一座由透明矩形模块搭成的阶梯式高塔。结构从画面底部宽而低的平台升起，向上收为少数方盒，许多玻璃般的细边交叉成规则网格。浅灰墙面立在其后，深色天花格架和一排明亮射灯沿上边缘出现。装置几乎填满画面宽度。叠置的方盒内有不同高度的小房间与平台，浅色楼梯在左侧和中央连接数层。部分内部区域发出暖白光，让纵深透过重叠透明墙面显现。几处小绿树或种植物立在结构内部，不规则叶片与严格直线网格对照。靠近中央，一间受光房间和一道较深开口打断清透表面的重复。左下方，一小段白楼梯向模块内攀升；右下方则是更紧密的方盒房间和狭窄竖向隔板。浅色实心基座斜过下方两角，支撑透明组合。相机从展厅地面略向上看，最高的透明盒靠近天花板，较低模块形成密集底座。头顶射灯和模块内部暖光带来零散反射与明亮边缘高光。清冷透明表面大体无色，但反复重叠产生灰、蓝白与银色调。纵深通过细线积累、透明度的小变化和偶尔的受光开口表达，而非深色墙面。照片仍让展厅环境足够可见以建立尺度，但清透房间的网格主导画面。整体构图以少量绿意和暖光平衡精确上升的几何结构，让繁复构造显得轻盈而有人气。
style_prompt_en: The photograph has a cool, high-key finish organized by stacked translucent planes and a fine rectilinear grid. Pale gray and blue white occupy broad areas, while small warm illuminated pockets and restrained green accents interrupt the near-monochrome field. Repeated clear edges overlap to create varying line density; a few solid surfaces provide anchors without closing the space. Light passes through thin boundaries, reflects from selected rims and gathers inside recessed volumes, making transparency and layering the main depth cues. Small irregular textures contrast with the precise geometry, keeping the visual rhythm from becoming uniform. The viewpoint lets lower layers feel dense and upper layers increasingly open. The overall treatment is airy and intricate, with clean lines, soft reflections and scattered warm points guiding the eye through the pale volume.
style_prompt_zh: 照片具有清冷的高调完成面，由叠置半透明平面和细密直角网格组织。浅灰与蓝白占据宽阔面积，少量暖色受光内区和克制绿色强调打破近单色场。重复清透边线相互覆盖，形成不同线密度；少数实心表面提供支点，却不封闭空间。光穿过薄边界，在所选边棱上反射，并聚在内凹体积中，使透明性与层叠成为主要纵深线索。少量不规则肌理与精确几何对照，避免视觉节奏过于均匀。视点让下层显得密集，上层逐渐开敞。整体处理轻盈而繁密，干净线条、柔和反射和散布的暖亮点引导视线穿过浅色体积。
theme_en: A stepped transparent modular structure displayed inside a bright gallery
theme_zh: 明亮展厅内陈列的阶梯式透明模块结构
name: Sou Fujimoto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
